commands:
read_verilog -formal -sv rtl/dot_engine.sv formal/numeric.sv
chparam -set MODE 0 -set MAGNITUDE 0 proof
prep -top proof -flatten
async2sync
chformal -lower
dffunmap
sat -seq 12 -set-init-zero -prove-asserts -verify
scope: Bounded arbitrary inputs, tags, reset and sink readiness; zero-initialized state; no unbounded or full-parameter proof
